functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_organization_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT organization_id
 FROM public.users
 WHERE id = auth.uid()
 LIMIT 1;
$function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER discovery_findings_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.discovery_findings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_discovery_updated_at()
